posts.author: kimmonismus
posts.text: Talking about scientific breakthroughs: GPT-6 Astra got several physics answers right that experts initially marked wrong. TheoPhysEval's authors found errors in the reference solutions and confirmed Astra was correct in those cases. Using Codex with tools and web access, it scored 49/50 (98%).

posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced $2 billion in European investments and new stakes in French startups like Doctolib and Entalpic. The UK gets $250 million in compute for AI agent safety and security research. Huang pitched open-weight models as Europe's way to close the AI gap. posts.text: AI guardrails designed to stop hackers are now blocking defenders, and Orion-1 aims to fill the gap. Artemis Security's new Orion-1 model is purpose-built for cyber defense and beats Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol on the company's own benchmark. The model fills a growing gap as general-purpose frontier models lock down their cyber capabilities, blocking defenders in the process. posts.text: Apple reportedly gearing up for strong iPhone 18 sales. While the iPhone 18 Pro is out, the entry-level model has been held back until early next year. But even this far ahead, one leaker has suggested that supply-chain orders indicate Apple is optimistic about demand for the base model … more…
